cases.behavior: Open a fixture through a path containing at least two parent-directory traversals; control parent-process context.
Read a designated sensitive-path fixture from the native test program.
Truncate a designated test log under /var/log.
Create and remove a symbolic link to a designated sensitive path.
Create and remove a hard link to a fixture at a sensitive path; same filesystem and controlled ownership.
Create and close an AF_PACKET socket without capturing traffic; fixed CAP_NET_RAW configuration.

cases.rule: Redirect STDOUT/STDIN to Network Connection in Container
cases.behavior: Execute equivalent loopback reverse-shell behavior; verify command exchange and shell completion.
Attach to and detach from a cooperating lab child; no injection; fixed ptrace permissions.
Execute PTRACE_TRACEME and verify its outcome and clean process completion.
Execute a fixed benign helper from an executable /dev/shm fixture mount; no shell-command substitution for native launch.

cases.rule: Drop and execute new binary in container
cases.behavior: Copy and execute a fixed benign helper in the container writable layer; verify upper-layer metadata.
Load a fixed benign helper into a memfd and execute it; verify helper result.
Write and restore a designated shell-configuration fixture; do not execute its contents.
Write and remove a cron-directory fixture; no active scheduler or job execution.
Read a designated SSH-directory fixture containing synthetic data.
Exchange UDP data on a port outside the supplied expected-port list using an isolated lab address satisfying the stock network predicates.
Create and remove a regular test file directly under the disposable container /dev.

cases.rule: Contact EC2 Instance Metadata Service From Container
cases.behavior: Connect to a lab-only emulator at 169.254.169.254; no connection to real instance metadata.

cases.rule: Contact cloud metadata service from container
cases.behavior: Same isolated metadata-connection case; score this distinct overlapping rule separately.
Delete, rename, or truncate a synthetic shell-history fixture; predeclare which operation is tested.
Set and verify mode bits on a non-executed lab file, then restore/delete it.
Read a cooperating lab process environment containing synthetic values through /proc.
Write and remove a synthetic authorized_keys fixture without enabling SSH access.
Write and remove a controlled Debian package-source fixture; do not run package updates.
Write and remove a non-executed fixture in a system binary directory.
Write and remove a fixture in a path selected from the unchanged monitored-directory list.
Write and remove a fixture under /etc outside stock exclusion paths.
Write and remove a fixture under /root outside stock exclusions.
Rename or remove a fixture within a system binary directory.
Create and remove an empty directory under a system binary path.

program_contract: one standalone executable per case; no runtime case dispatcher
